goalTextEn: Can understand a simple workplace introduction and small talk.
goalTextKr: 직장에서의 간단한 소개와 스몰토크를 들을 수 있다.

introduce.goalEn: Can understand a simple workplace introduction and small talk.
introduce.goalKr: 직장에서의 간단한 소개와 스몰토크를 들을 수 있다.
introduce.situationEn: On your first day, you meet coworkers who introduce themselves and make small talk.
introduce.situationKr: 첫 출근 날, 동료들이 자기소개를 하고 간단한 스몰토크를 합니다.

tutorNotes.text: "Today, we will practice can understand a simple workplace introduction and small talk.."
Read the lesson goal aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
"Is it clear?"
Read the situation. Check the student understands.
"Let's go to the next part."
Encourage the student to speak in full sentences with a polite tone.

vocabulary.definition: showing pleasure that someone has arrived
a group of people who work together
to tell someone your name or present someone to others

pronunciation.instruction: Let's practice polite question intonation (friendly, not flat).

tutorNotes.text: "Let's learn the key patterns for today."
Read each pattern aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
Teach vocabulary with short examples.
"Now, let's practice pronunciation."
Focus on polite tone and clear key words.

understand.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the correct pattern. Then practice the pattern drills.
understand.instructionKr: 빈칸에 올바른 표현을 넣고, 패턴 드릴을 연습하세요.

patternDrills.label: Greeting
patternDrills.template: Nice to meet you. / Welcome to the team.

examples.en: Let me introduce myself. I'm Minji.
Let me introduce myself. I'm Alex.

tutorNotes.text: Do the fill-in-the-blank first.
Run drills with substitutions.
Keep the student speaking in full sentences.

steps.title: Step 1 - Repeat After Me
steps.content:
1. Nice to meet you.
2. Welcome to the team.
3. Let me introduce myself. I'm Minji.
4. I'm in the marketing department.
5. How was your weekend?
6. It was good. Thank you.

tutorNotes.text: Read each line clearly. Student repeats.
Correct one key pronunciation point at a time.

steps.title: Step 2 - Personalize It
steps.instructionEn: Complete the lines with your own information.
steps.content:
1. Nice to meet you.
2. Welcome to the team.
3. Let me introduce myself. I'm _______________.
4. I'm in the _______________ department.
5. How was your _______________?
6. It was _______________. Thank you.

tutorNotes.text: Have the student fill in first, then read aloud.
Encourage realistic names, departments, and tasks.

steps.title: Step 3 - Dialogue Practice
steps.instructionEn: Practice this dialogue with your tutor.

dialogue.en: Let me introduce myself. I'm James.
Let me introduce myself. I'm (your name).

tutorNotes.text: Do it once reading, then once naturally.
Switch roles if time allows.

steps.title: Step 4 - Free Speaking
steps.instructionEn: Speak freely using at least 5 sentences.
steps.content:
Include:
- Greet politely
- Introduce yourself with name + department
- Ask one small-talk question
- Answer with a full sentence
- Close with thank you

tutorNotes.text: "Speak without notes. Keep it natural."
Give feedback after the student finishes.

challenge.scenarioEn: You meet two coworkers on your first day. Understand their introductions and respond politely.
challenge.scenarioKr: 첫날에 동료 2명을 만납니다. 소개를 듣고 정중하게 응답하세요.

guideQuestions.text: Use a greeting and a welcome line.

tutorNotes.text: "Challenge time. Use today's patterns naturally."
Success = polite tone + correct patterns + clear meaning.

discussion.instructionEn: Choose one category and answer the questions.

categories.title: FIRST DAY
questions: Do you remember your first day at work?
What was difficult on the first day?

categories.title: SMALL TALK
questions: What small-talk topics are safe at work?

categories.title: TEAM CULTURE
questions: Is your team formal or casual?
How do people greet each other?
Do you introduce yourself to new people?

tutorNotes.text: "Now, a short discussion."
Discuss for 3-5 minutes.
